summary: Retest of the iteration_103 fixes plus a regression run of the discount and promo flow. Backend: test_promo_codes.py passed 16/16 and the new test_promo_fixes_iter104.py passed 11/12, so 27 of 28 tests pass. Every requested fix is verified: (1) a Каталог save no longer wipes discount_*, discount_tiers or promo_* fields (checked by API and in the UI: set a tiers-only discount in Скидки и акции, renamed the product in Каталог and saved, then reopened the editor and the value, end date and tier were all still there); (2) validate now applies the min_price floor cap: on card, 1100×2 with a 15% code returns 300 (not 330), and the order recorded promo_code_amount=300; when the floor eats the whole discount, validate returns valid:false with 'Промокод не даёт скидку...'; (3) PUT validates percent>100, value<=0 and bad type, and rejects duplicate codes (404 for an unknown id); (4) a valid_until of today is still valid; (5) per_user_limit no longer counts cancelled orders; (6) an order whose promo is floored to 0 has promo_code=None and used_count stays 0; (7) a tiers-only discount saves (UI) and applies (cart price 900 at the tier qty); (8) promo_remaining_stock is no longer reset when promo_allocated_stock is not sent. Full UI lifecycle works: admin create, duplicate rejected, edit 500% rejected, edit, delete; client applies the code in the cart and sees the −300 line; the order stores TESTUI104P/300 and used_count went to 1. The combined product discount + tier + promo held at the floor exactly (2550 = 850×3). One small backend gap: negative limits are still accepted. There are also a few display mismatches between what the cart/product page shows and what the server charges.

minor.issue: _validate_code_fields does not check that the limits are non-negative. max_uses=-1, per_user_limit=-3 and min_order=-100 all return 200. The review request claimed this check was added. Harmless at runtime because <=0 is treated as unlimited, but invalid data is stored.
Still open from iteration 103: cancelling a promo order does not decrement promo_codes.used_count, so max_uses gets used up by cancelled orders. The max_uses check plus $inc is still not atomic.

ui_bugs.issue: Still open from iteration 103: the cart showed Доставка 500 ₽ and К оплате 2 400 ₽, but the server charged delivery_fee 0 and a total of 1 900 ₽ (user@demo.com has an individual delivery_cost). The UI uses delivery.delivery_price and ignores the user's delivery_cost.

With cash (−10%) on a product priced 1000 with min_price 950, the cart shows 900×2 (total 2 300 ₽ with delivery), but the server clamps each item to 950 (goods 1900). The cart under-states the total whenever a payment-method discount crosses the floor. The promo code part is handled correctly now (validate returns valid:false).
The tier preview shows 'от 3 шт. −8% 920 ₽/шт' for price 1000 with min_price 950, but the server will charge 950. The preview ignores the floor.
A tiers-only discount (discount_active=true, value 0) shows the badge '−0%'. It should show 'тиры' (or the best tier).

issues: 'Действует до' still uses the native browser date picker (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the shadcn Calendar

action_items: Add min_order>=0, max_uses>=0, per_user_limit>=0 checks to _validate_code_fields (promo_codes.py)

CartPage: use the user's individual delivery_cost for the delivery row, and clamp each item's adjusted price to min_price (or get these numbers from a server-computed cart preview) so 'К оплате' matches the order total
ProductPage tier preview: clamp the tier price to min_price (or have the server return a floor-safe tier price)
DiscountsPromoTab badge: show 'тиры' when discount_value is 0 and tiers exist
Optional: decrement used_count when a promo order is cancelled; make the max_uses check atomic (find_one_and_update with a used_count < max_uses filter)
critical_code_review_comments: validate_code trusts the goods_total sent by the client, while the floor comes from the server cart. A client can inflate goods_total to get a larger preview. It is display-only because create_order recomputes everything, but deriving goods_total on the server would remove all drift.
AdminPage.js is still about 4000 lines and orders.create_order is still about 400 lines; promo, floor and payment logic should move into helpers
update_product drops None values, so discount_until and promo_allocated_stock still cannot be cleared to 'без лимита' from the editor (from iteration 103, not re-addressed)
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_promo_codes.py (fixture now snapshots and restores user@demo.com's cart and empties it before the validate tests, since validate now depends on cart contents)

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all requested flows pass; remaining issues are display mismatches in the cart and product page)
